text: USA or China. Who's winning the AI race? Let's check the scoreboard.
Round one: the smartest AI. The best American model beats the best Chinese one by just two point seven percent.
Three years ago, that gap was huge.
Round two: computing power. America has about seventy-two percent of the world's AI computing power. China? About ten.
Round three: electricity. AI eats power, and China is adding power plants about six times faster than America.
Round four: the shock. In January twenty twenty-five, a cheap Chinese AI called DeepSeek wiped nearly six hundred billion dollars off Nvidia in one day.
Right now, America leads. But China is catching up, fast and cheap. The race isn't over. It's barely past the first lap.
